title: 第9章 生命大欲第10章 重视
slug: 我金丹呢你当结石摘出来了
lines: 苏业站在窗前，闭上眼睛。
感知铺展开来的瞬间。
苏业心中剧震。
天地之间，千丝万缕，有着淡淡的丝线衔接天穹深处，又仿佛流水一般蕴着。
那是莹白色极细极淡的丝线，肉眼完全不可见，但在他的感知中却清清楚楚，它们漂浮在空气里，无处不在，像是被风吹散的蛛丝，又像是阳光下飘荡的微尘，没有固定的方向，没有规律的轨迹，只是静静地悬浮着，缓慢地流动着。
“这些丝线到底是什么？”
苏业伸出手，试探性地张开五指。
那些丝线从他的指缝间穿过，没有任何触感，像是不存在一样。
苏业收回手，重新闭上眼睛。
这些‘丝线’似乎是原本便存在于天地之间的，只不过因为苏业完美融合了水系金丹雏形，获得了某种‘感知’的能力，方才看到它们。
那么或许使用精神力才是正解。
这是苏业第一次开始动用自己的精神力。
一缕‘丝线’在苏业精神力的摄取下，被牵动，摇颤着坠下，从眉心处涌入。
灼热。
一股细微但极其鲜明的灼热感从眉心炸开，沿着额头、太阳穴、后脑勺，一路蔓延到脊柱，再从脊柱分散到四肢百骸。
苏业能够清晰地感受到那缕丝线经过的每一寸路径，所过之处，刺痛，灼热，像是一根烧红的细针在他的神经上缓缓划过。
痛！
但身体在贪婪地吸收，每一寸细胞都发出欢呼，仿佛寻找到了宝藏的海盗。
‘丝线’在体内走了一个完整的循环后，迅速被分解、吸收、融入血肉之中，消失得无影无踪。
这一瞬，身体的变化来了！
心跳加速。
咚，咚，咚。
沉稳有力，一下一下，宛如空谷内响彻的雷声。
苏业猛地睁开眼。
精神百倍。
不，不只是精神百倍，是整个身体都像是被注入了一股全新的能量，血液流动的速度加快了，肌肉里仿佛流淌着用不完的劲，连视野都比刚才更清晰了一个层次。
就吸收了一缕而已。
苏业长长地深吸一口气，缓缓吐出。
“与我猜的没错，这些天地之间的丝线，是灵气，难怪从见到起，我的身体便表现出了极度的渴望。”
他低声说出了这个词。
在诸多小说的熏染下，苏业对于这个词汇并不陌生。
灵气。
是这天地之间无尽生灵进化的钥匙。
那个大学生体内的金丹雏形，就是在这种灵气的浸润下自然结晶出来的产物，而苏业完美融合了那枚水系金丹之后，才终于获得了感知灵气、吸收灵气的能力。
一缕灵气入体。
效果就像是吃了什么猛药一样，龙精虎猛，精力十足。
苏业活动了一下手脚，感受着体内那股充沛的力量感，眼中闪过一丝兴奋。
“这就是修行的感觉？痛并爽快！”
他再次闭上眼，凝聚精神，去牵引第二缕灵气。
这一次明显吃力了许多。
感知探出去的时候，他能感觉到自身精神力的虚弱，好不容易锁定了一缕灵气，牵引入体的过程也变得艰涩，那缕灵气在眉心处停滞了两三秒才勉强涌入。
content_en:
Su ye stood in front of the window and closed his eyes.
Feel the unfolding moment.
Su ye was shocked.
Between heaven and earth, there are thousands of threads, and there are faint threads connecting the depths of the sky, and they are like flowing water.
They were very fine and light silk threads of crystal white color, completely invisible to the naked eye, but they were clear to his perception. They were floating in the air, everywhere, like spider silk blown away by the wind, or like dust particles floating in the sun. They had no fixed direction or regular trajectory, they just floated quietly and flowed slowly.
"What are these threads?"
Su ye stretched out his hand and tentatively spread his fingers.
Those threads passed through his fingers without any touch, as if they didn't exist.
Su ye withdrew his hand and closed his eyes again.
These 'threads' seemed to have originally existed between heaven and earth. It was only because Su ye perfectly integrated the prototype of the water system golden elixir and gained some kind of 'perception' ability that he could only see them.
Then maybe using mental power is the right answer.
This was the first time Su ye started to use his mental power.
A strand of 'silk thread' was pulled by Su Ye's mental power, trembling and falling, pouring in from the center of his eyebrows.
searing.
A subtle but extremely distinct burning sensation exploded from the center of the eyebrows, along the forehead, temples, and back of the head, spreading all the way to the spine, and then spreading from the spine to the limbs.
Su ye could clearly feel every inch of the path that the thread passed. Wherever it passed, it was stinging and burning, like a red-hot fine needle slowly tracing across his nerves.
pain!
But the body is greedily absorbing it, and every cell in the body is cheering, like a pirate who has found a treasure.
After the 'silk thread' went through a complete cycle in the body, it was quickly decomposed, absorbed, integrated into the flesh and blood, and disappeared without a trace.
At this moment, the body changes!
Heartbeat speeds up.
Boom, boom, boom.
Calm and powerful, one after another, like thunder resounding in the empty valley.
Su ye opened his eyes suddenly.
A hundred times more energetic.
No, not only was he more energetic, but his whole body seemed to have been injected with a new energy. The blood flow speed increased, his muscles seemed to be flowing with endless energy, and even his vision was a level clearer than before.
Just absorbed a wisp.
Su ye took a long, deep breath and exhaled slowly.
"My guess is correct. These threads between heaven and earth are spiritual energy. No wonder my body has shown extreme desire since I saw them."
He whispered the word.
Influenced by many novels, Su ye is no stranger to this vocabulary.
Reiki.
It is the key to the evolution of endless creatures between heaven and earth.
The prototype of the golden elixir in the college student's body was the product of natural crystallization under the infiltration of this spiritual energy. After Su ye perfectly integrated the water-based golden elixir, he finally gained the ability to sense and absorb spiritual energy.
A ray of spiritual energy entered the body.
The effect is like taking some strong medicine, full of vigor and energy.
Su ye moved his hands and feet, feeling the abundant power in his body, and a hint of excitement flashed in his eyes.
"Is this what it feels like to practice? It hurts and feels good at the same time!"
He closed his eyes again and concentrated his energy to attract the second ray of spiritual energy.
This time it was obviously much more difficult.
When his senses came out, he could feel the weakness of his own mental power. He finally locked on a ray of spiritual energy, and the process of pulling it into his body became difficult. The strand of spiritual energy stagnated at the center of his eyebrows for two or three seconds before reluctantly pouring in.
"hiss."
